units.source_text: 朱雀帝谨守上皇遗言，多方爱护源氏。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku carefully honored the Retired Emperor's last wishes and protected Genji in many ways.

units.source_text: 然而他年事尚轻，加之性情太过柔顺，毫无强硬气概，万事听母后及外祖父右大臣做主，绝不违背。

en.t: Yet he was still young, and because his nature was far too gentle and yielding, with no forceful spirit at all, he left everything to his mother and his maternal grandfather, the Minister of the Right, and never opposed them.

units.source_text: 如此，他对朝廷政治自然无权过问了。

en.t: In this way, he naturally had no authority to intervene in the affairs of the court.

units.source_text: 因此源氏处身行事，每多失意。

en.t: As a result, Genji was often frustrated in how he could conduct himself and manage his affairs.

units.source_text: 然而那位尚侍胧月夜偷偷地恋慕源氏，两人虽非容易，但也有时暗中幽会。

en.t: Even so, Oborozukiyo, the lady chamberlain, secretly loved Genji, and although it was not easy for them, they sometimes met in secret.

units.source_text: 有一次，五坛法会开始，朱雀帝洁身斋戒。

en.t: On one occasion, when the five-altar Buddhist service began, Emperor Suzaku purified himself and entered ritual abstinence.

units.source_text: 两人便乘此机会，重温旧梦。

en.t: The two of them took this opportunity to relive their former dream.

units.source_text: 尚侍的侍女中纳言君巧妙布置，避去人目，将源氏大将引导到一间廊房里，

en.t: The lady chamberlain's attendant, Chuunagon no Kimi, arranged matters skillfully, avoided watching eyes, and led General Genji into a gallery room.

units.source_text: 正像那年初欢时弘徽殿里的廊房一样。

en.t: It was just like the gallery room in Kokiden where they had first shared their pleasure that year.

units.source_text: 法会期间，来往人多，这个房间又靠近廊下，因而中纳言君提心吊胆。

en.t: During the service many people were coming and going, and since the room was also near the corridor, Chuunagon no Kimi was deeply anxious.

units.source_text: 源氏的美貌，即使是朝夕见惯的人，也百看不厌，

en.t: Genji's beauty was such that even those who saw him morning and evening never tired of looking at him.

units.source_text: 何况胧月夜难得见面，安得不神魂颠倒！

en.t: How much more, then, must Oborozukiyo, who could rarely see him, have been utterly entranced.

units.source_text: 这女子相貌也很艳丽，又值青春年华；

en.t: This woman too was very radiant in appearance, and she was in the full bloom of youth.

units.source_text: 虽然不免轻狂，亦自有温柔优雅、天真烂漫之趣，

en.t: Although she could not help being somewhat frivolous, she also had a charm that was gentle, elegant, innocent, and unspoiled.
Genji too felt that he could never tire of looking at her.
